# QLTerm C R1 (third-party, GPL-3.0-or-later)

`orig/` is the supplied `QLTERM-C-R1-FULL-SOURCE.zip` (`qltc/` tree), SHA-256
`fb7e46c112c494fe756eb20f9af8672ec52b0e513b627443a6416b625c3edd5b`, byte-identical (verify with
`cd orig && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`). It is never edited. The QDOS/386 port applies `r14-qdos386.patch` to a build
copy (see docs/R14-QLTERM-PORT-MAP.md and docs/R14-LICENSE-PROVENANCE.md).
